extraction_notes: SS38 uses the 'SS38-SS310' dotted curve in Fig.3 and the 'SS38-SS320' dashed curves in Fig.4, per the figure legends.

Curves digitized from a 400 dpi raster; curve assignment by left-to-right legend ordering (Fig.3) and top-to-bottom temperature ordering (Fig.4). Estimated read error about +/-0.01 V (Fig.3) and +/-10 percent of value (Fig.4, dashed-line gaps).
Fig.4 x-axis preserved as printed: percent of rated peak reverse voltage; 100 percent corresponds to VRRM = 80 V for SS38.
High-temperature table leakage, not to be fitted as 25 degC data: IR = 10 mA max at VR = VDC, Ta = 100 degC (p. 2).

No reverse recovery time is published for this family; reverse_recovery is null. No breakdown row exists; VRRM = 80 V (p. 1) is an absolute maximum rating, not a measured breakdown, so breakdown fields are null.
In forward_voltage_points the current entry is the exact specified test condition (source_kind 'typical'); the voltage entry is a datasheet maximum.
Fig.1 (current derating vs lead temperature) and Fig.2 (surge current vs cycles) were not digitized: thermal/surge ratings, not junction I-V characteristics.
Additional ratings on p. 1 (SS38 column): VRRM = 80 V, VRMS = 56 V, VDC = 80 V, IF(AV) = 3.0 A, IFSM = 80 A @ 8.3 ms half-sine, RthJA = 80 degC/W, RthJL = 20 degC/W.
Manufacturer footer full name: Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd (www.ichjc.com).
